item.title: Rubbish from bin by bus stop, 23rd August
item.description:

item.title: Dead leaves and litter , need sweeping and taking away and litter picked as well.., 23rd August
item.description:
The stretch of the pavement on marked area ( from Radnor Road to Peckham Hill Street junction) needs proper sweep of leaves please. It has been neglected for months. As well as that , litter picking is needed as not done since last report. The pavement is wide and unpleasant. Litter is disposed of all over, next tothe curb, the brick wall, next to trees, mixed within masses of leaves and generally all over. Please send a team to address all of the above issues and add this area to scheduled cleaning. There are charging points for cars on this stretch but no bin provided so people just throw rubbish on the pavement. Maybe provide a bin there as well? Thanks, I hope this will be brought back to a pleasant state

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Commercial Way, Peckham, Greater London
